/* v0.5.1: PDF-based hierarchy labels. Primary column remains within captured table geometry. */
.hierarchy-toggle{flex:none;border:1px solid #d9e1ea;border-radius:7px;background:#f9fbfd;color:#526779;padding:8px 11px;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;white-space:nowrap}
.hierarchy-toggle.selected{color:#1e5a82;background:#eaf3fa;border-color:#b9d2e6}
.table-el thead th.hier-header{background:#595d62;color:#fff;position:relative}
.header-depth-mark{display:none}
.table-el tbody th.level-label{border:1px solid #7a7f86;vertical-align:middle;padding:2px 5px;text-align:left;font-size:13.8px;line-height:1.1;color:#1f2730;background:#fff;font-weight:650;min-width:0;max-width:100%;overflow:hidden;white-space:nowrap;cursor:help}
.table-el tbody tr:nth-child(even) th.level-label{background:#fbfbfb}
.table-el tbody tr.row-total>th.level-label,.table-el tbody tr.row-total>td{background:#e8edf2!important;border-top:1.7px solid #4f5358;border-bottom:1px solid #7a7f86}
.table-el tbody tr.row-total>th.level-label{font-weight:800;color:#182029;box-shadow:none}
.table-el tbody tr.row-subtotal>th.level-label,.table-el tbody tr.row-subtotal>td{background:#f1f4f7!important;border-top:1.2px solid #9ba0a6}
.table-el tbody tr.row-subtotal>th.level-label{font-weight:760;color:#1e2630;box-shadow:none}
.table-el tbody tr.row-group>th.level-label,.table-el tbody tr.row-group>td{background:#edf1f5!important;border-top:1.4px solid #7a7f86}
.table-el tbody tr.row-group>th.level-label{font-weight:790;color:#17212b}
.table-el tbody tr.row-metric>th.level-label{color:#3e4d5b;font-size:12.8px;font-weight:600}
.table-el tbody tr.row-unknown>th.level-label{color:#7f858d;font-style:italic}
.level-label-inner{position:relative;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:0;width:100%;min-width:0}
.row-label-text{min-width:0;max-width:100%;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;display:block}
.row-kind-badge{display:none}
.row-total .row-kind-badge{display:none}
.row-subtotal .row-kind-badge{display:none}
.level-1.row-detail th.level-label>.level-label-inner{padding-left:8px}

/* v0.5.12: maximize in-cell readability by enlarging text and trimming padding */
/* v0.5.11: improve readability within fixed geometry and shade major summary rows */
/* v0.5.10: stronger child-level distinction for items like 감가상각비 */
.level-2.row-detail th.level-label,
.level-2.row-metric th.level-label{background:#f6f9fc!important;color:#495a69}
.table-el tbody tr:nth-child(even).level-2.row-detail th.level-label,
.table-el tbody tr:nth-child(even).level-2.row-metric th.level-label{background:#f2f7fb!important}
.level-2.row-detail th.level-label>.level-label-inner,
.level-2.row-metric th.level-label>.level-label-inner{padding-left:28px}
.level-2.row-detail th.level-label>.level-label-inner::before,
.level-2.row-metric th.level-label>.level-label-inner::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:14px;top:-8px;bottom:-8px;width:1px;background:#c2ced9}
.level-2.row-detail th.level-label>.level-label-inner::after,
.level-2.row-metric th.level-label>.level-label-inner::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:14px;top:50%;width:10px;height:1px;background:#c2ced9}
.level-2.row-detail .row-label-text::before,
.level-2.row-metric .row-label-text::before{content:"";display:inline-block;width:5px;height:5px;border-radius:50%;background:#8fa5b8;margin:0 8px 1px 0;vertical-align:middle}
.level-2.row-metric th.level-label{font-size:10.9px;color:#516171}

.level-3.row-detail th.level-label,
.level-3.row-metric th.level-label{background:#fbfcfd!important;color:#617181}
.table-el tbody tr:nth-child(even).level-3.row-detail th.level-label,
.table-el tbody tr:nth-child(even).level-3.row-metric th.level-label{background:#f7fafc!important}
.level-3.row-detail th.level-label>.level-label-inner,
.level-3.row-metric th.level-label>.level-label-inner{padding-left:40px}
.level-3.row-detail th.level-label>.level-label-inner::before,
.level-3.row-metric th.level-label>.level-label-inner::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:14px;top:-8px;bottom:-8px;width:1px;background:#d4dde5;box-shadow:16px 0 0 #d4dde5}
.level-3.row-detail th.level-label>.level-label-inner::after,
.level-3.row-metric th.level-label>.level-label-inner::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:30px;top:50%;width:10px;height:1px;background:#d4dde5}
.level-3.row-detail .row-label-text::before,
.level-3.row-metric .row-label-text::before{content:"";display:inline-block;width:5px;height:5px;border-radius:1px;background:#b7c6d2;margin:0 8px 1px 0;vertical-align:middle}
.level-3.row-metric th.level-label{font-size:10.6px;color:#68798a}
.depth-legend{position:absolute;z-index:4;left:47px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:17px;width:1230px;font-size:11px;line-height:19px;color:#60758a;pointer-events:none}
.depth-legend span{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;white-space:nowrap}
.depth-legend b{width:14px;height:9px;border-radius:2px;border:1px solid #b8cbd9;display:inline-block}
.depth-legend .legend-total{background:#dfeaf3;border-left:3px solid #3a6684}
.depth-legend .legend-sub{background:#ecf2f7;border-left:3px solid #7a9fb5}
.depth-legend .legend-detail{background:#fff;border-left:2px solid #c1cfdb}
.depth-legend .legend-caveat{color:#a0a8b1;font-size:10px}
@media(max-width:1200px){.depth-legend .legend-caveat{display:none}.capsule{display:none}}

.toolbar-level-key{font-size:11px;color:#647789;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;margin:0 5px 0 2px;white-space:nowrap}
.toolbar-level-key>span{width:9px;height:9px;display:inline-block;border-radius:2px;border:1px solid #b8cbd9;margin-left:7px}
.toolbar-level-key .key-total{background:#ffffff;border-left:3px solid #4f5358}
.toolbar-level-key .key-sub{background:#f3f3f3;border-left:3px solid #9ba0a6}
.toolbar-level-key .key-detail{background:#fff;border-left:2px solid #c1cfdb}
@media(max-width:1200px){.toolbar-level-key{display:none}}

/* v0.5.8: screenshot-faithful two-row header. The total ('당월') is a tall
   row-spanned cell, and the associated entity labels sit one row lower. */
.table-el thead tr.nested-upper th{height:24px;line-height:15px;padding-top:2px;padding-bottom:2px}
.table-el thead tr.nested-upper th.nested-tall{height:48px;vertical-align:middle}
.table-el thead tr.nested-upper th.nested-sum{background:#4e6782!important;color:#fff!important;font-weight:750;border-left:1px solid #6f8599;border-right:1px solid #6f8599}
.table-el thead tr.nested-upper th.nested-cap{background:#6a839d!important;opacity:1;border-bottom:1px solid #6f8599;height:21px;padding:0;line-height:1}
.table-el thead tr.nested-lower th{height:26px;padding:2px 3px;line-height:1.1;background:#d8e0e8!important;color:#2f4a61!important;font-size:13.2px;font-weight:700;border-top:0;border-bottom:1px solid #7a7f86;white-space:normal}
.table-el thead tr.nested-upper th.hier-header{background:#595d62!important}


/* v0.5.8: sticky table header within vertically scrollable captured sections.
   Stick the entire THEAD instead of individual TH elements to preserve
   merged / row-spanning two-tier (당월 + 법인별) column geometry. */
.scroll-region .table-el thead{
 position:sticky;
 top:0;
 z-index:20;
 background:#595d62;
}
.scroll-region .table-el thead th{
 background-clip:padding-box;
}
/* Keep header grid lines visible while body passes underneath it. */
.scroll-region .table-el thead{box-shadow:0 1px 0 #7a7f86}



/* v0.5.13: explicit final font sizes and contrasting levels within existing cell bounds. */
.table-el thead th {font-size:14.5px;font-weight:750;letter-spacing:-.15px;padding:4px 4px;}
.table-el tbody td {font-size:15.2px;font-weight:600;padding:2px 4px;line-height:1.12;}
.table-el tbody tr td:first-child {font-size:15.2px;font-weight:650;}
.table-el tbody th.level-label {font-size:15px;font-weight:650;padding:2px 5px;line-height:1.1;}
.table-el thead tr.nested-upper th {font-size:14px;}
.table-el thead tr.nested-lower th {font-size:13.5px;}
/* Summary rows: shade the entire row rather than the left label only. */
.table-el tbody tr.row-total>th.level-label,
.table-el tbody tr.row-total>td {background:#dfe8f0!important;}
.table-el tbody tr.row-group>th.level-label,
.table-el tbody tr.row-group>td {background:#e8eef4!important;}
.table-el tbody tr.row-subtotal>th.level-label,
.table-el tbody tr.row-subtotal>td {background:#f0f3f7!important;}
.table-el tbody tr.level-1:not(.row-total):not(.row-group):not(.row-subtotal)>th.level-label {background:#eef2f6!important;}
.table-el tbody tr.level-0 th.level-label {font-size:15.2px;font-weight:800;color:#162c3e;}
.table-el tbody tr.level-1 th.level-label {font-size:15px;font-weight:760;color:#213647;}
.table-el tbody tr.level-2:not(.row-total):not(.row-subtotal):not(.row-group) th.level-label {font-size:14.5px;font-weight:550;color:#425363;}
